translation: Pyrolusite (無名異, stir-fried), wood ear (木耳, stir-fried), Sichuan rhubarb (川大黃, each five qian). Grind all together into powder, mix with honey water and apply. If there is stagnant blood within, prick it out and then apply; if there is a putrid area, it is even better to apply Dang Gui Ointment (當歸膏). <ins>Divine-Effective Dang Gui Ointment (神效當歸膏)</ins> This ointment closes the wound and generates flesh, draws out toxins and stops pain, and for all sores where the toxic qi is congested and abundant, rotting and turning into pus.
